cards.text: Picture it, friend: the LORD speaks to Joshua, Israel's leader, and tells him to have the Israelites designate the cities of refuge. And this isn't brand new, because God already gave these instructions through someone else. Me, I need to hear 'preheat the oven' THREE times before it sticks.

cards.question: The LORD tells Joshua He already gave the instructions for the cities of refuge through ___.

cards.text: These cities will be a refuge from the avenger of blood. When somebody has to RUN, God says this is where he runs TO.

cards.question: Who does God say can flee to a city of refuge?

answers.text: Someone who kills another by accident
Someone who steals from a neighbor

cards.text: God says when someone flees to one of these cities, he stands at the entrance of the city gate. If anybody chased ME, friend, I'd be hopping along on this gold base and get there sometime next Tuesday.

cards.question: God says the one who flees stands at the city gate and states his case before the city's ___.
God says that after the one who flees states his case at the city gate, the elders make him camp outside the walls.

cards.text: Hold on, hold on, HOLD ON. God covers this too: what if the avenger of blood pursues him all the way to that city?

cards.question: God says that if the avenger of blood pursues the one who fled to the city of refuge, the elders must not hand him over.

cards.text: But God says his stay in that city is NOT a quick stop, like ducking under an awning till the rain quits.

cards.question: How long does God say the one who fled must stay in the city of refuge?

answers.text: Until his trial and the high priest's death
Until the avenger of blood gives up
Until seven full years have passed

cards.question: Once the high priest serving at that time dies, where does God say the one who fled may go?

answers.text: To a different city of refuge
Out to live in the wilderness

cards.text: So they set apart three cities: Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.

cards.question: Where do they designate the other three cities of refuge?

answers.text: Beyond the Jordan east of Jericho

cards.text: Over there they designate Bezer on the wilderness plateau, Ramoth in Gilead and Golan in Bashan. SIX safe places, friend, and back in the junk drawer I spent years in, my only safe spot was under a takeout menu.
Then the last verse spells out exactly who these six cities are for.

cards.question: Who are the six cities of refuge appointed for?

answers.text: The Israelites and the foreigners among them
The Israelites but not the foreigners
The foreigners but not the Israelites
